description: A made-up broken scan cleaned into a game-ready asset. The scan is a faceted rock or a fluted, cracked column (revolved from a profile), roughened with scan noise and then damaged: patches of missing faces, an open underside, flipped and duplicate faces, a crumpled self-intersecting patch and floating debris. Two mesh_repair passes weld it, drop the duplicates, fix the winding and fill every hole; the largest piece is kept (the debris goes); a voxel remesh rebuilds one watertight surface, which removes the tangles; taubin smoothing (more passes for longer edges) and an isotropic remesh make even triangles of edge_length. The asset sits on the ground at the origin, named after its source, in a plain stone material, with smooth normals and uv unwrapped into the 0..1 square for a texture whose size (detail int texture_size, a power of two) gives about texel_density pixels per metre. lod makes the levels of detail from it, each keeping lod_ratio of the triangles of the one before. Asserts guard one closed outward piece without self-intersections, no edge shorter than a fifth of edge_length, and every uv inside 0..1.

source.label: source
source.desc: the made-up scan to clean: a lumpy rock or a cracked column

edge_length.label: edge length
edge_length.desc: edge length of the cleaned mesh (m)

lods.label: lods
lods.desc: levels of detail after the full one

lod_ratio.label: lod ratio
lod_ratio.desc: share of the triangles each level keeps of the one before

texel_density.label: texel density
texel_density.desc: texture pixels per metre the uvs are laid out for

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: changes the made-up scan, not the cleanup

params.code:
@P = add(@P, mul(@N, 0.15 + 0.15 * rand(@ptnum, seed)));
f@pscale = 0.6 + 1.2 * rand(@ptnum, seed + 1);

sealed.note: Workaround for F-127: mesh_repair (max_hole_edges 0) sometimes leaves a small hole (3 open edges) or a non-manifold edge after one pass on this damage; a second pass closes it. Drop it once one pass is enough.

look_scan.note: the scan before cleanup, moved as the cleaned asset was and set one place to its left

asset.label: Asset
asset.description: The cleaned asset: one closed, outward-facing piece of even triangles about edge_length long, on the ground at the origin, with smooth normals, uv inside the 0..1 square (detail texture_size: the texture size it is laid out for) and the stone material; prims named rock or column.

lods.label: Levels of detail
lods.description: The asset's levels of detail, all at the origin and sharing its uv: LOD0 (the full asset) and lods coarser levels, each keeping lod_ratio of the triangles of the one before; each level is a piece named <source>_lod<level> with prim int lod.
